canonical_project: Oran AI Data Center / Akid Lotfi AI computing center
owner: Government of Algeria / Ministry of Post and Telecommunications; Algérie Télécom-linked public initiative
notes: DCD reported on 2025-03-20 that the Algerian government had broken ground on an AI data center in Oran's Akid Lotfi district, with the foundation stone laid by Post and Telecommunications Minister Sid Ali Zerrouki. DzairAI's 2025-03-16 report, citing APS and Algeria News Gate, says the facility is Algeria's first AI-dedicated high-performance computing center and will use latest-generation GPUs for researchers, universities, and startups. No MW capacity was disclosed.
